roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this full-time position, you will play a key role in developing and implementing educational programs for staff, as well as overseeing and managing the facility's infection control program. We offer a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to make a significant impact on our facility's quality of care and staff competency.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to infection control and staff education
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing efforts for a recently acquired center, playing a pivotal role in its growth and community engagement. We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional who is eager to make a significant impact.The ideal candidate will be highly presentable and possess a strong drive to succeed, with the ability to work occasional weekends as required. This role offers excellent compensation for the right individual who can effectively build relationships and drive census growth in a competitive market.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Professional demeanor and appearance, representing the facility with excellence
Demonstrated ability to be proactive, results-driven, and effective in market development
Strong understanding of local healthcare market dynamics and referral networks
Ability to work occasional weekends to support facility events and outreach

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN scheduling, allowing you to make a significant impact on patient recovery while maintaining a work-life balance.

As an SLP, you will be instrumental in providing comprehensive speech, language, and swallowing therapy services to our residents. This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a supportive team environment focused on delivering high-quality patient care. We are offering a competitive hourly rate and a generous sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome you to our team.

If you are a compassionate and skilled Speech Language Pathologist looking for a rewarding PRN position, we encourage you to apply and learn more about this critical opening.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus available.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity allows you to provide essential therapy services, contributing to patient recovery and improved quality of life.

In this role, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing treatment plans designed to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and achieve their rehabilitation goals. This flexible PRN position is ideal for a professional looking to make a significant impact while managing their own schedule.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting preferred
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00 per hour, based on experience.
